OPEN · PROGRESS REPORTED

A proposed proof was withdrawn after experts found gaps, while a separate conditional strengthening remains unverified, so the conjecture is open.

Saxl proposed in 2012 that the tensor square of the staircase representation contains every irreducible representation of the relevant symmetric group.

KNOWN RESULTS AND DECEMBER 2025 WITHDRAWAL

Pak, Panova, and Vallejo (2013) proved occurrence for hooks and two-row partitions.
Ikenmeyer (2014) proved occurrence for every partition comparable with the staircase in dominance order, including all hooks.
Soong Kyum Lee’s December 2025 paper claimed a complete proof, but was withdrawn after expert reviewers identified mathematical gaps and stated that the claim was unjustified in its current form.
Later work gives further families and structural positivity results, but not positivity for every partition.
